messages:
Aisha K: quick UX thread: invoice rows + currency localization in Usage dashboard. Two schools of thought: show primary localized currency then USD secondary, or show USD primary and localized in tooltip. Thoughts?
Devon L: localized primary, USD secondary. Most customers prefer seeing familiar currency up-front.
Priya S: fine, but two lines per row doubles height. can we keep single-line like: "$0.0007 (≈ €0.00065) per token" so it's compact?
Maya P: accessibility nit: do not rely on '≈' alone. screen readers can mispronounce it. use words for sr-only span, e.g., "$0.0007 (about €0.00065) per token" or provide aria-labels.
DesignBot: mock uploaded -> https://redwood.design/mock/usage-invoice-rows-localization-v2 (compact single-line + secondary small meta).
Aisha K: next: invoice download CTA placement. Option A: sticky right column CTA (global). Option B: per-row kebab menu for row-level export. Org view often has many invoices.
Devon L: sticky CTA for common bulk-downloads, per-row kebab for row-specific formats. sticky can show last-export status and selected filters.
Priya S: agree. also role-based columns: finance users need gross/VAT lines; product teams only net. how do we avoid confusing non-finance users?
Maya P: implement column toggles (persisted). hidden finance columns show a gray lock icon with "Hidden for your role" tooltip. toggles must be keyboard focusable and announce state (aria-pressed).
FinanceBot: legal reminder: EU accounts require VAT line on exported PDFs. ensure PDF export always includes VAT breakdown even if column hidden in UI.
Devon L: chart micro-interaction: sparklines in invoice rows should be keyboard-focusable. suggestion: tab to sparkline opens mini-overlay with text summary (e.g., "Total tokens: 3.2M; peak day: 210k") and Next/Prev point controls.
Priya S: mobile constraints: accordion rows that reveal chart and token breakdown on expand. performance concern: rendering many charts hurts list scrolling. Lazy-load charts on expand or use canvas + draw only visible rows.
Maya P: color/contrast: current red/orange palette fails AA at small sizes. propose new marker set or patterned lines (dashed/solid) for print and color-blind accessibility.
Aisha K: copy debate: primary button reads "Download invoice" vs "Export invoice (PDF)". which is clearer?
Devon L: "Download invoice" is simpler; avoid locking format in label. add a small chevron for format choices.
Priya S: agree. Users expect PDF by default. chevron menu for CSV/JSON.
Maya P: a11y checklist summary: scope toggle must use role="tab" or aria-pressed, expand rows use aria-expanded, chart gets aria-describedby + a non-visual text summary, all interactive icons have aria-labels, hover info has keyboard focus fallback.
DesignBot: action items: 1) Priya -> deliver compact single-line mock with sr-only currency text + locked-column tooltip (due Tue). 2) Devon -> write perf notes for lazy-loading charts and provide implementation options (canvas vs svg) (due Wed). 3) Maya -> accessibility spec (aria attributes + keyboard flows) and updated color suggestions (due Wed). 4) Eng/Product to confirm default download label w/PM (Aisha to own decision after finance input) (due Fri).
FinanceBot: I'll surface VAT/export legal note to PMs.
Aisha K: scheduling 20m follow-up if folks want to walk mocks. thanks :thumbsup:
